cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. In October 2026 the e-service was still expanding, with nearly 300,000 births recorded.
cells.note: The birth e-service recorded nearly 300,000 births by October 2026 but was still expanding across the country, and e-notification was to reach all SHA hospitals by December 2026. National digital birth registration is not shown, so it stays at 2.
